main.remarks: Represents signature, certificate-resolution, and trust facts.

property.name: Signed
property.summary: True when the evaluated key carries outer signature metadata; otherwise false.

property.name: VerificationAttempted
property.summary: True when signature verification was attempted for the evaluated key.

property.name: SignatureValid
property.summary: True when signature verification succeeded; otherwise false.

property.name: SignerToolID
property.summary: Tool identifier claimed by the outer signature metadata.

property.name: SignerAccessManagerID
property.summary: Issuing access-manager identifier claimed by the outer signature metadata.

property.name: Algorithm
property.summary: Signature algorithm evaluated for the key.

property.name: SignerKeyIDFormat
property.summary: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier.

property.name: SignerKeyID
property.summary: Signer key identifier bytes evaluated during verification.

property.name: CertificateResolved
property.summary: True when the validator resolved a matching certificate for the declared signer key identifier.

property.name: CertificateThumbprint
property.summary: Thumbprint of the certificate used during verification when one was resolved.

property.name: SignerTrusted
property.summary: True when the signer identity is trusted by the validation policy.

property.name: ChainTrusted
property.summary: True when the certificate chain satisfies the configured trust requirements.
